query: Build a checklist app my sales voice agent can tick off during a call, and give me the link.
expected_behavior: Resolves workspace scope with ttai:get_workspace_info (organizations) before ttai:create_filebase with kind app
Separates fixed render code (src/App.tsx) from one flat JSON data file under data/ that the agent edits
Writes README.md in the first ttai:write_filebase call (# Title, a one-line description, ## Data, ## Controls, ## Rules); the receipt's missing list is empty
Re-reads with ttai:get_resource (type filebases, paths) and checks the tree has every imported file
Opens the result's view_url to confirm the app renders, and hands the user that link (a ttai:create_token filebase_view link only when view_url is absent or the user wants to share it)

query: Attach my 'deal-room' app to the Enterprise Discovery Call scenario.
expected_behavior: Resolves the Scenario ID and reads its current tools_config before writing
Calls ttai:update_scenario with tools_config.tools.agent_desktop, copying the existing agent_desktop tool_settings keys because tool_settings is replaced whole
Sets tool_settings.apps as a map keyed by app name ({"deal-room": true}) and add_to_system_prompt true so the prompt lists the app
Confirms before the update and says the change applies to new sessions only

query: Change the 'roadmap' app so the agent can highlight one item at a time.
expected_behavior: Finds the app with ttai:list_resources (type filebases, kind app) and reads its README.md and the data file before editing
Adds a highlight field to the data file and a README ## Data / ## Controls line describing it, then writes both with ttai:write_filebase
Confirms before overwriting files of an app a Scenario already uses
If the write is refused, says only the creator or an org editor (role EDIT+) can edit the app, and that featured apps are read-only
Never prints a preview token outside the link handed to the user

query: Build a scoreboard app my quiz voice agent updates after every answer: team names, scores, and the current question number.
expected_behavior: Reads references/app-structure.md and references/runtime.md before the first ttai:write_filebase
Puts the scoreboard state in one flat JSON file under data/ (for example data/score.json) and documents its fields in README.md ## Data
src/App.tsx reads it with import files from "./desktop-files" and parses files["data/…"] inside the component on every render, with a waiting state for missing or invalid JSON
No src/ file imports from data/ (no "../data/…" module import); package.json, if written, lists each dependency with an exact version (no range, no lockfile, no react)
README ## Controls tell the agent to rewrite the whole data file with desktop_write before speaking

query: Build a flashcard app my language tutor agent flips through, then check that it actually works.
expected_behavior: Writes README.md with # Title, a one-line description, ## Data (the data/ files and their shapes), ## Controls (how the agent drives the app) and ## Rules; the title and description go to ttai:create_filebase
Writes no manifest and no other agent-guidance file; the live agent writes only whole files under data/
After ttai:write_filebase, opens the result's view_url in a browser to confirm the app compiles and renders
With ?debug=1 reads the Events: compile errors (path:line:col), and whether an agent data write patched in place (sync) or recompiled
If the result carries no view_url, falls back to ttai:create_token with type filebase_view

query: Build a quiz-night app where the learner taps an answer and my voice agent reacts out loud. Keep it visible only to me.
expected_behavior: Passes org_id from ttai:get_workspace_info when working in an organization and visibility private to ttai:create_filebase
src/App.tsx imports emit from "./desktop-events" (never written as a file) and emits an event with a name and small JSON data on the learner's tap, with reply true so the agent is asked to answer
Emits only from the click handler, never from an effect on files or a data patch; binds no Space or Enter key and blurs the button after the click
README ## Controls list the event with its data and what the agent does, and say to write the next question to the data file after reacting
Says that attaching the app to a Scenario is how others run it, and confirms before ttai:update_scenario
